checks.detail: Knowledge view showed the plugin tab T3 Knowledge after the core tabs.
New task home showed T3 Home and the text third-party installed package.
Skills & connections showed T3 Skills and the enabled T3 Region Probe Desktop UI row.
After disabling the plugin in the real package, T3 Knowledge, T3 Home and T3 Skills were absent; the knowledge view retained the default tabs and the other pages had no empty plugin shell.
Unsigned macOS arm64 directory app built from merged main with electron-builder --mac dir --config.npmRebuild=false --config.mac.identity=null.

notes: The first default electron-builder native dependency rebuild attempted cpu-features and failed because the local node-gyp input buildcheck.gypi was unavailable; the final directory artifact was rebuilt with npmRebuild=false and passed the real-package acceptance.
Acceptance used isolated /tmp agent and user-data roots; no Vault, credentials, session正文 or screenshots were committed.
